about: Renfrew is a town in Renfrew County, Ontario, on the Bonnechere River in the Ottawa Valley west of Ottawa. A historic timber-and-mill service centre, it has a brick downtown, river parks, and a role as a highway-town hub at Highways 17 and 60. About 8,000 people live in Renfrew.
seoSummary: Ottawa Valley town on the Bonnechere—timber-town downtown at Highways 17 and 60, west of Ottawa.
knownFor: Bonnechere River town in the Ottawa Valley
